# Supertext Plugin Health (bundled copy)

Built JavaScript of the TypeScript part of [Supertext Plugin Health](https://github.com/Supertext/Commando-Center-Supertext-Translation/tree/main/plugin-health) (`plugin-health/typescript`), version 0.1.0, commit `2393242b47a58bdd70ecb54d2636a076c0ea3769`. `package.json` only marks the files as ES modules.

Don't edit these files: fix it in Commando-Center-Supertext-Translation/plugin-health, then run `scripts/vendor-plugin-health.sh`.
